name: ClickHouse Loom
description: Self-hosted MCP server for shared agent memory, cited document retrieval and code intelligence, with local embedding and LLM options.
compatibility: MCP over Streamable HTTP (plus mcp-remote bridge for stdio-only clients).
LLM jobs on Ollama, llama.cpp llama-server, or other OpenAI chat-completions endpoints via LOOM_LLM_PROVIDER=local, alongside the released image's bundled CPU embedder.
Claude Code and Codex plugins, plus MCP setup helpers for Cursor, VS Code, Cline, Windsurf, Zed, Gemini CLI and OpenCode.
limitations: Released as v1.3.0 (evidence pinned to main at commit 06544c04). This entry has not qualified a local-model runtime or any OS or hardware target; upstream notes that prompts and thresholds are tuned on hosted models and no published benchmark covers a local model.

Self-hosted deployment needs Docker with Compose (WSL 2 on Windows) or a Kubernetes cluster via the Helm chart; platform and hardware tags are omitted because physical target tests are not established for this entry.

The released Docker image carries a local bge-small CPU embedder and defaults to a fake-echo-1 placeholder LLM unless the interactive installer detects Ollama or LOOM_LOCAL_MODELS=ollama is set. A source checkout defaults to fake embedding and LLM providers.

Local LLM jobs require a separately installed Ollama or llama.cpp server with a large context window (upstream recommends OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 for extraction). The local preset disables the capture verifier, conflict resolver and entity extraction to protect small local models.

Local providers do not guarantee offline operation or private client behavior. Hosted provider overrides, independently configured coding clients and optional ClickStack OTLP or Langfuse trace exports can send processed data elsewhere.

sources.note: Shared memory, document search, code intelligence, self-hosted deployment and coding-agent integrations.
Released Docker installer, Compose and WSL 2 prerequisites, bundled local bge-small embedder versus fake LLM default, interactive Ollama detection, and source checkout defaults.
Local Ollama and llama.cpp configuration, context window and local-preset trade-offs, unbenchmarked local quality caveat, and per-job hosted overrides.
Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, mcp-remote stdio bridge, Claude Code and Codex plugins, and loom install client helpers.
Document retrieval with source citations; the calling agent or model writes the answer.
Self-hosted Kubernetes deployment with the Helm chart.
Default local ClickHouse telemetry storage and optional export to a configured OTLP endpoint.
Optional trace export to a separately configured Langfuse service.
